subject: Junior Civil Draftsperson application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello LC Water team,

I'm applying for the Junior Civil Draftsperson role in Geelong that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings and checking work against them. I'm based in Melton VIC with a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert says the role shows how drawings turn into real construction, and that is what I want from my first drafting job: site layouts, slabs, foundations and access roads updated from engineer mark-ups. My CAD work so far is from study rather than commercial drafting, and I haven't worked on water or wastewater projects yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: LC Water designs and builds water and wastewater treatment plants from its North Geelong office and workshop, and does its civil design in-house.
letter.subject: Junior Civil Draftsperson, Geelong
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Civil Draftsperson role in Geelong advertised on SEEK. Your advert says the role shows how engineering drawings translate into real construction, and that is the start I want in civil drafting.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against them to cut down on rework. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I kept site reports, material records and progress reports.

I am based in Melton VIC with an Australian driver's licence, my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My CAD experience is from study rather than commercial drafting, and I have not yet worked on water or wastewater projects, so I would value the on the job training your team offers.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
